purpose: release admission for Social Studies source integrity

classes.STATIC_VERIFIED_SOURCE: A named source set was verified against the repository that holds it. Admissible.
classes.DYNAMIC_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Evidence is selected at teaching time under DYNAMIC_SOURCE_REQUIREMENT. Admissible only when dynamicState is ATTACHED_SATISFIED.
classes.UNRESOLVED: No verified static source set and no dynamic contract. Held back.
classes.NOT_ASSESSED_BY_SOURCE_REGISTRY: Outside both registries. This lane makes no claim; admissible is null, not true.

whatTheDynamicValidatorChecks: The shape of an attestation: required fields, declared kind and tier against the contract's own vocabularies and against each other, the adult's read-in-full and preview record, recorded dates inside the revalidation window, and the unit's authority rules. Not whether the source says what the adult says it says -- that is the adult's attestation, and no validator settles it.
